q: Enzymes are protein molecules formed in the living ____.
e: Enzymes are protein molecules formed in the living cells. The cell is the basic living unit; tissues are groups of similar cells. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: They are biological catalysts and all the metabolic processes of the living things are catalysed by ____.
e: They are biological catalysts and all the metabolic processes of the living things are catalysed by them. Them is the biological term this statement needs.

q: Enzymes that are isolated from the cell still retain their ability to ____.
e: Enzymes that are isolated from the cell still retain their ability to function. Function is what a structure does in the living body. Enzymes can still work after they are isolated from the cell; that is why we use them in industry.

q: This property of enzymes is put to use in industrial processes which require high temperature or pressure to ____.
e: This property of enzymes is put to use in industrial processes which require high temperature or pressure to work. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: They are much cheaper to use and the cost for industrial processes are reduced as they do not require expensive fuel to maintain high temperature to ____.
e: They are much cheaper to use and the cost for industrial processes are reduced as they do not require expensive fuel to maintain high temperature to function. Function is what a structure does in the living body.

q: Many enzymes used in industries are obtained from microorganisms mostly from fungi or ____.
e: Many enzymes used in industries are obtained from microorganisms mostly from fungi or bacteria. Microorganisms are microscopic living things such as bacteria, protozoa, and many fungi. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: Application of useful enzymes is seen in many industries like baking and brewing industries， dairy industry and textile ____.
e: Application of useful enzymes is seen in many industries like baking and brewing industries, dairy industry and textile industry. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: Even in medicine and pharmaceutical industry microbial trypsin is used to treat blood clotting and pancreatic trypsin is used for treatment of ____.
e: Even in medicine and pharmaceutical industry microbial trypsin is used to treat blood clotting and pancreatic trypsin is used for treatment of inflammation. Inflammation is a defensive response with heat, redness, swelling, and pain. Applied biology includes medicine, which restores and maintains human health.

q: Commercial fermentation produces many enzymes that are useful to man. They include proteases， the protein-digesting enzymes and lipases， the fat-digesting ____.
e: Commercial fermentation produces many enzymes that are useful to man. They include proteases, the protein-digesting enzymes and lipases, the fat-digesting enzymes. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Fermentation is microbial chemical change of organic material, with or without oxygen in modern use.

q: These enzymes are used to make biological washing powder and stains in clothes cause by blood， egg， gravy and grease can be removed ____.
e: These enzymes are used to make biological washing powder and stains in clothes cause by blood, egg, gravy and grease can be removed easily. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: The enzyme proteases act on red haemoglobin and break it down into smaller molecules which are colourless and dissolve in ____.
e: The enzyme proteases act on red haemoglobin and break it down into smaller molecules which are colourless and dissolve in water. Water is the essential solvent of cells and a raw material of photosynthesis. Haemoglobin in red blood cells binds oxygen for transport.

q: Both the protein and fat molecules are large but the proteases and lipases digest them into small， soluble substances which pass out of the fabric and are washed ____.
e: Both the protein and fat molecules are large but the proteases and lipases digest them into small, soluble substances which pass out of the fabric and are washed away. Proteins are polymers of amino acids with many structural and catalytic jobs.

q: Fungi produce the pectinases enzymes which are used in extracting fruit ____.
e: Fungi produce the pectinases enzymes which are used in extracting fruit juices. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up.

q: The enzymes break down pectin， a jelly like substances between the cell walls and separate the fruit cells making it much easier for extracting the ____.
e: The enzymes break down pectin, a jelly like substances between the cell walls and separate the fruit cells making it much easier for extracting the juice. Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed reactions without being used up. Juice is cleared when pectin is broken, not because cellulose and starch flood out.

q: During the break down process many kinds of polysaccharides (such as cellulose and starch) are also released causing the juice to become ____.
e: During the break down process many kinds of polysaccharides (such as cellulose and starch) are also released causing the juice to become cloudy. Cellulose is the beta-glucose polymer that makes plant cell walls rigid. Starch is the plant storage polysaccharide made of amylose and amylopectin.

q: Pectinases continue to break them down to sugar making the juice sweeter and ____.
e: Pectinases continue to break them down to sugar making the juice sweeter and clearer. An extra chromosome 21 produces Down's syndrome.
